findings.actualCrossingVerdict: No blocking defect found in the actual 70 proposed crossings; isolated research preparation only.
findings.relativeLevelHandling: Ground road intersections require matching current source railway geometry and positive railway layer; positively annotated road structures are excluded from proposal authority. Relative source levels are not absolute surveyed altitudes.
findings.radiusAndRoadWideClassification: The largest circle is 144 m, but all actual applied proposed finite spans are contiguous and their endpoints lie within 11.93617110511527 m of the audited crossing. No disconnected same-pair application or unintended extra crossing was reproduced.
findings.auditDuplicate: The sole duplicated same road/rail pair is f9ca4507-643_1 / w930897350, with identical point [-643.3,5758.0] on a shared railway vertex; it is not a remote second crossing.

bridgeTerminology.requiredWording: source railway bridges; reserve beam for ways that explicitly confirm bridge:structure=beam
